results.name: Cosmonaut on a rocket
Venusian Cosmonaut
results.description:
This 3D asset pack was produced for CQUniversity: MMST13009 3D Character Design's Assignment 2: Textured 3D Character and Self Assessment

The year is 199X. As the space race continues to grow more intense, human travel beyond Earth is commonplace. As part of this new era, the Soviets vowed to conquer the boiling. brutal environment of Venus as proof of their superiority and strength. Their most important men in achieving this goal are the Venusian Cosmonauts.

results.name: The Cosmonaut (Old and New Version)
results.description:
In ROUTINE, you enter the Union Plaza Moon Base as a hired Software Engineer, tasked with finding out what happened aboard the station for the ASN to be in lockdown.
Old version only had the helmet textures but the body was there so i ported it too.
Models belong to Lunar Software, from the game ROUTINE. I am posting them here in case anyone wants to inspect them up close.

The Space Suit from the game Rust.

results.name: Mercenary Astronaut
results.description:
Mercenary Astronaut 3d model. This model was started a couple years ago for the never finished and never published another yet nonamed Indi Project. And it was staying on my hdd disk with work-in-progress condition. You know, when you start some project, and never finish it. So I thought it needed to be done. Because this model I did with big time gaps, it needs to be retextured and remodelled some parts.. I'm not satisfied yet, but I think it must be finished anyway. So I hope you like it.
It is absolutely free for your game or CG project, you can use it freely..
Textures are overweight, 4096px, and it can be decreased to the smallest one.
Model consists of some stuff and it can be turned off. Pauldrons, backpack cargo boxes, iron cargo boxes, antenna and fonar, back frame for cargo, can be disabled, for customization.
I hope you liked it!
